focus: Small follow-ups only: review fixes from build 42 (Keyed brace tokens, follower filters, save pruning) and the inviteChance default 0.6 -> 0.8
diffSource: since build 42 (2026-10-10T20:39:20Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: A downed follower carried out is silently captured as a prisoner and never gets the join/leave roll
findings.detail: With the new !Downed filter in TryAccept, a downed follower (dropped from LordJob_DwellersWait by Notify_PawnLost Incapped, so AllSendablePawns lists it as auto-capturable) goes into leftToLoad, is hauled into the stash, and FlushStash calls caravan.AddPawn, which captures any non-player humanlike (CaravanUtility.ShouldAutoCapture). TryResolveFollowerOut only runs from TryMovePawnOut, and its Comp(dweller.Map) is null for an unspawned stashed pawn anyway. Single change: in FlushStash, before caravan.AddPawn, check the site map comp's followers for the stashed pawn and run the join/leave resolution there (or, if capture is intended, message the player).

findings.title: Downed transition removes the follower from its lord, which is what makes it listable for capture
findings.detail: Pawn_HealthTracker calls GetLord()?.Notify_PawnLost(pawn, Incapped) on downing, so the non-caravan-sendable LordJob_DwellersWait no longer blocks AllSendablePawns; CanListAsAutoCapturable then admits the factionless follower. The new comment in TryAccept is accurate about the path.

findings.title: Removing the 5%/95% clamp allows 0% and 100% invite chances
findings.detail: InviteChance is now Clamp01(setting * SocialImpact): slider at 0 offers a 0% invite that always marks the dweller refused for good, and high social impact reaches a guaranteed 100%. Design choice, not a defect.

findings.title: Players who explicitly chose 0.6 are migrated to 0.8
findings.detail: Scribe_Values.Look with DefaultInviteChance omits values equal to the default when saving, so an explicit 0.6 was never written and now loads as 0.8. Players who never touched the slider getting 0.8 is presumably the intent.

findings.title: A downed follower that recovers before being hauled may stall the leave
findings.detail: Opinion, not verified by a run: once in exit.leftToLoad, a follower who stands back up cannot be carried, so the load may not complete until the dialog is reopened (Recache then routes it through SendThroughExit).
